This template is to be used for citing individual pages on [[Electronic Arts]]' [https://ea.com official website].

==Usage==
Copy the template code below and paste it into the appropriate place in an article. Fill in the required fields plus as many of the optional fields as necessary and remove any that you don't use.

<code><nowiki>{{EA|subdomain=|url=|text=|int=|author=|date=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=}}</nowiki></code>

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|url}} URL of the web page, minus the domain name (<code><nowiki>https://www.ea.com/</nowiki></code>).
*{{Para|text}} Name of the page being cited.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|subdomain}} The subdomain part of the web page's URL.
*{{Para|int}} [[Wookieepedia]] link, if available.
*{{Para|author}} Name(s) of the author(s). Multiple authors must be separated with a "<code>;</code>" between their names. Note that an author is not necessarily an individual and could be an organization. A long list of authors can be reduced using "<code>, et al.</code>" after the first name. Provide wikilinks whenever they are available.
*{{Para|date}} Full date of publication, in [[Wikipedia:ISO 8601|ISO 8601]] <code>YYYY-MM-DD</code> format, for example "<code>date=2006-02-17</code>".

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
;Standard use

<code><nowiki>{{EA|url=news/the-future-of-ea-and-star-wars-games|text=The Future of EA Star Wars™ Games|author=Jade Raymond|date=2016-06-12|archivedate=20190915014924}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{EA|url=news/the-future-of-ea-and-star-wars-games|text=The Future of EA Star Wars™ Games|author=Jade Raymond|date=2016-06-12|archivedate=20190915014924}}

<hr />
;With a Wookieepedia link

<code><nowiki>
{{EA|url=games/starwars/squadrons/cg-short-hunted|int=Hunted|text=Star Wars™: Squadrons – “Hunted” CG Short|date=2020-09-15|archivedate=20200914164206}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{EA|url=games/starwars/squadrons/cg-short-hunted|text=Star Wars™: Squadrons – "Hunted" CG Short|int=hunted|date=2020-09-15|archivedate=20200914164206}}

<hr />
;With no backup available

<code><nowiki>{{EA|url=games/starwars/battlefront/star-wars-battlefront-2/news/letter-to-the-community-original-era-content|text=After 2+ Years Of Free Content, The Vision For Star Wars™ Battlefront™II Is Now Complete|date=2020-04-28|nobackup=1}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{EA|url=games/starwars/battlefront/star-wars-battlefront-2/news/letter-to-the-community-original-era-content|text=After 2+ Years Of Free Content, The Vision For Star Wars™ Battlefront™II Is Now Complete|author=Dennis Brännvall|date=2020-04-28|nobackup=1}}

<hr />
;With a subdomain

<code><nowiki>{{EA|subdomain=starwars|url=starwars/battlefront/news/survival-mission-e3-2015-deep-dive|text=''Star Wars''™ Battlefront™ Missions: Take on the Empire Solo or Co-Op with a Friend in Survival|nolive=1}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{EA|subdomain=starwars|url=starwars/battlefront/news/survival-mission-e3-2015-deep-dive|text=''Star Wars''™ Battlefront™ Missions: Take on the Empire Solo or Co-Op with a Friend in Survival|nolive=1}}
